objective: Make the Pi root-model setup treat defaultProvider and defaultModel as one pair, so setup never writes a route model next to a provider set by hand, or a route provider next to a hand-set model.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-model, branch release/0.3.0/feat/pi-root-model at its newest commit (the root model setup in packages/runtime/src/setup/pi-settings.ts and rootModelSettings in packages/runtime/src/pi/provider.ts).

Current behaviour judges each key alone: with defaultProvider set by hand and defaultModel unset, setup writes the route model id beside the other provider, giving Pi a model that may not exist for that provider. Change it: write defaultProvider and defaultModel together only when both are unset (in the scope file and, at project or local scope, in the global file as now); when either is set, write neither and let doctor report the model as a hand-set choice. defaultThinkingLevel stays independent.
Undo, the record and doctor follow the pair; add tests for provider-only and model-only cases at user and project scope.
